_about: One row per place the plugin touches Skyrim. target: the CommonLibSSE-NG symbol or event. address_id: Address Library id for 1.6+/1.7 builds (null until looked up and confirmed in the running game on 1.7.104). Each row becomes one hook class in src/hooks/.

rows.purpose: start as .asi without SKSE: thread, wait for RE::UI, create trampoline, derive data-loaded/new-game/load-game
read mouse delta, attack/block/feint/scroll before the game does; swallow vanilla attack
rows.target: BSInputDeviceManager event sink (mouse movement, per-frame tick); the attack button itself is taken in attack_start

rows.purpose: start a sheet-defined attack on an actor; block vanilla attack start
rows.target: AttackBlockHandler::ProcessButton, vtable slot 4 (<= 1.6.x) or 6 (>= 1.7.99, two functions were added before it)

rows.purpose: feint/morph: stop current attack animation and state

rows.target: own state machine clock per swing: windup -> release -> recovery

rows.purpose: decide parry/chamber/flinch/damage before Skyrim applies a melee hit
rows.target: RE::HitData::Create (damage by Skyrim's rules, armour included), then the game's own melee hit processing: the function its hit-frame handler calls, trusted only when that call site matches (AE builds); plain Actor::DoDamage otherwise. Parry/chamber/flinch decisions go in front of this later
rows.address_id: call at id 38627 + 0x4A8 -> id 38586 (checked at startup); HitData ids 42832/44001

rows.purpose: hit by the weapon's real path during release instead of Skyrim's cone
rows.target: per frame in release: blade segment (WEAPON node to the far edge of the weapon model's bounds), swept from the previous frame, against an upright capsule on each nearby actor (ProcessLists high actors)

rows.purpose: write retargeted MORDHAU bone transforms after Skyrim's animation update, 1st and 3rd person
rows.target: ThirdPersonState::Update (vtable slot 3), after the original: write NiNode local rotations for the mapped bones and twist bones, UpdateDownwardPass from the top driven bone, then refresh the skeleton's BSFlattenedBoneTree (node-backed entries from their nodes, node-less entries such as fingers from their parents). First person not done.

rows.purpose: choose direction, parry, riposte, feint for humanoid NPCs in combat
rows.target: per-frame over ProcessLists high actors in combat

rows.purpose: MORDHAU movement: forward-only sprint with build-up, slower strafe/backpedal, jump stamina cost, turn cap in release
rows.target: BGSMovementType run speeds of the humanoid on-foot stances (NPCDefault, NPC1HM, NPC2HM, NPCBow..., NPCSprinting) set from MORDHAU at data load, in memory; the player's SpeedMult corrects to the exact value (one-time measurement per session) and carries the sprint build-up; fJumpHeightMin from MORDHAU's jump velocity and gravity; stamina cost on take-off

rows.purpose: draw the HUD and hide Skyrim's bars/crosshair in combat
rows.target: D3D11 swap chain Present (BSGraphics::Renderer) + HUDMenu visibility

rows.purpose: find the player's MORDHAU install (Steam libraryfolders.vdf, app 629760) and open its paks read-only
enemies never shield-bash: MORDHAU has no bash, and a bash staggers the player out of a duel
rows.target: every TESCombatStyle: meleeData bashMult, bashRecoilMult, bashAttackMult, bashPowerAttackMult set to 0 once the game's data is loaded (in memory only)
